filter_dimension_scope: complete annual network nodes, including missing coordinates

geographic_flow_explorer.anchor_method: unweighted spherical mean of distinct organization coordinates supplied by OpenAlex; display anchor only, not a geographic centroid
geographic_flow_explorer.arc_geometry: 32-point spherical great-circle interpolation between sourced display anchors
geographic_flow_explorer.color_semantics: arc and partner-marker color encode target macro-region; selected source uses its stable macro-region color and a distinct diamond outline
geographic_flow_explorer.display_filter_order: apply minimum selected collaboration weight and minimum partner share, then rank cross-geography flows by selected metric with target label and stable geography ID tie-breaks; internal flow does not consume a Top N arc slot

line_width_definitions.normalized_intensity: width_px = 0.8 + 7.2 * sqrt(min(normalized intensity, 1.0)); values above 1 saturate at 8.0 px
line_width_definitions.volume: width_px = min(8.0, 0.8 + 2.25 * log10(1 + selected collaboration weight))

geographic_flow_explorer.normalized_intensity_definition: fractional collaboration weight divided by the geometric mean of source and target full institutional Work-count denominators under the same scope
geographic_flow_explorer.partner_share_definition: selected endpoint weight divided by all selected endpoint weight attached to the source geography; an internal flow contributes two source endpoints
geographic_flow_explorer.time_window: inclusive complete calendar years from 2010 through 2025

known_limitations: Institution coordinate coverage is reported per view; coordinates are never invented.
Geographic anchors are research-institution coordinate means for display, not geometric or political centroids.
Network and Topic pages use a thresholded 500-node core and top 1,000 edges per view.
The Topic registry is provisional and has not received human review.
The corpus-boundary annotation sample is unlabelled and awaits human review.
2025 is the last complete calendar year; no partial 2026 data are included.
Visualization score is non-primary and used only to rank visible edges.
Community continuity matches below Jaccard 0.25 are explicitly uncertain.
source_policy: processed aggregate datasets only; no API requests during viewing
